params.body:
The `systems` MCP server offers GLK's worksheets app as `glk_*` tools, the way it offers Stocklist as `stocklist_*`.

- `lib/system-tools.mjs`: asking a system's menu, keeping the last one, reading one tool, and telling out of reach from refused. This moves out of `stocklist-read.mjs`, which keeps its exports and now only names the platform.
- `lib/glk-read.mjs`: the app's slug (`glk-transferor`) and address (`GLK_URL`, by default the Forge staging address).
- `mcp/glk-tools.json`: the menu as the app serves it, for a machine that never reached the app.
- `mcp/systems.mjs`: `menuTools()` serves both systems. The GLK tools say their radius (B1, `glk.read`) and that they never name a worker.

The app side is a glk-transferor change (`GET /api/control/tools`); Portal names the system and the kind in a change of its own. Until both are merged and reading is admitted, a call to a `glk_*` tool comes back with Portal's refusal as its reason.

Tests: `lib/glk-read.test.mjs`, plus one test in `mcp/systems.test.mjs`. 64/65. The failure is already on main: `stocklist-read.test.mjs` expects five tools in the snapshot, and the snapshot has had six since `photos_sample` was added.
